name: ExecutiveLimo
generic_identity: ExecutiveLimo - generic stretch executive limousine (no brand, no logos; emblem = one abstract chevron)

units.source: https://create.roblox.com/docs/physics/units (1 stud = 28 cm), same factor as CityCar

frame.origin: ground level, car centre line, half-way between the axles

DriverSeat.note: position = cushion top centre, LookVector = where the passenger faces. rig_root_studs = where to put an R6 HumanoidRootPart (DrivePlan convention: 1.5 above the seat surface, head + cap 2.32 above the root), moved over the rear of the cushion and lowered ('sink_into_cushion') so the head stays 0.05 under the measured headliner. r6_fit lists the numbers at scale 1 and at the game scale.

DoorL1.note: ground point 0.55 m outside the body side, facing the car (character HumanoidRootPart goes 3 studs above). It sits just behind the OPEN door (Door_Driver at its open angle): a standing R6 footprint (2 x 1 x 5 studs, +0.1 stud margin) there touches neither the open door, its glass, the body, the mirrors nor the wheels. DoorL1 = driver door, DoorL2 = rear-left door, DoorR2 = rear-right door (kerb side at the Port Meridian VIP stand, whose kerb is on the car's right).

game_fit.note: Scale 0.950 (game_scale) keeps the width over the mirrors inside DrivePlan.CAR_WIDTH.limo = 7.4. The car is then 25.8 studs long instead of the part-built 21: it overhangs the 22-stud gold pad by about 1.9 studs at each end, but the lay-by bays are 48 studs apart, so two cars still leave about 22 studs between them. Model:ScaleTo(scale_to_match_CAR_LENGTH_21) fits the old 21-stud slot, but the cabin then gets too low for seated R6 rigs.

game_scale.why: width over mirrors 7.30 studs <= DrivePlan.CAR_WIDTH.limo 7.4 (HQ B1 lane clearance) while the cabin keeps the real proportions; seated R6 rigs need the rig roots from anchors_at_scale (lowered so heads stay under the headliner)
game_scale.how: clone:ScaleTo(0.95) - the Model pivot is the origin on the ground, so every pivot and anchor position scales by 0.95 (rig roots: anchors_at_scale, already lowered for the headliner)

objects.name: Body
objects.role: painted shell with shut lines, wheel wells, black pillar posts, frit, cowl, wipers, antenna fin, plates, light housings, front passenger door (does not open)
objects.note: paint zone is WHITE in the vertex colours: Body.Color = paint (midnight 18,20,27)

objects.name: Glass
objects.role: clear glass: windshield, front passenger window, headlight covers

objects.name: GlassPrivacy
objects.role: tinted privacy glass: 4 stretch windows, rear window, partition window

objects.name: Chrome
objects.role: DLO surround, belt + lower side strips (body parts), passenger door handle, projector bezels, exhaust tips, trunk emblem

objects.name: Grille
objects.role: multi-bar grille, chrome surround, centre badge (one abstract chevron on a black plaque)

objects.name: Lights_Front
objects.role: LED DRL light guides, projector lenses, high-beam LEDs, amber indicators
objects.note: Material = Neon when the lights are on (put SpotLights at anchors Headlight_L/R)

objects.name: Lights_Rear
objects.role: full-width tail light bar, light blades, third brake light, reflectors

objects.name: Mirror_L
objects.role: left door mirror (lofted housing, arm, glass, LED indicator) on the A-pillar sail (does not move with the door)
objects.note: cap is paint (white vertex colour) -> Color = paint like Body

objects.name: Mirror_R
objects.role: right door mirror on the A-pillar sail
objects.note: cap is paint (white vertex colour) -> Color = paint like Body

objects.name: Door_Driver
objects.role: opening door: outer panel, jamb faces, door card (armrest, wood, handle, speaker), belt + lower chrome strips, handle
objects.note: paint zone white -> Color = paint like Body
objects.hinge_note: vertical hinge at the door's front edge (3 cm ahead of it, on the body's widest line). Left doors open with a negative angle about +Y, right doors with a positive one; the door glass (Door_Driver_Glass) uses the same pivot and angle.

objects.name: Door_Driver_Glass
objects.role: frameless door glass; moves with Door_Driver

objects.name: Door_RearL
objects.role: opening door: outer panel, jamb faces, door card (armrest, wood, handle, speaker), belt + lower chrome strips, handle
objects.note: paint zone white -> Color = paint like Body
objects.hinge_note: vertical hinge at the door's front edge (3 cm ahead of it, on the body's widest line). Left doors open with a negative angle about +Y, right doors with a positive one; the door glass (Door_RearL_Glass) uses the same pivot and angle.

objects.name: Door_RearL_Glass
objects.role: frameless door glass; moves with Door_RearL

objects.name: Door_RearR
objects.role: opening door: outer panel, jamb faces, door card (armrest, wood, handle, speaker), belt + lower chrome strips, handle
objects.note: paint zone white -> Color = paint like Body
objects.hinge_note: vertical hinge at the door's front edge (3 cm ahead of it, on the body's widest line). Left doors open with a negative angle about +Y, right doors with a positive one; the door glass (Door_RearR_Glass) uses the same pivot and angle.

objects.name: Door_RearR_Glass
objects.role: frameless door glass; moves with Door_RearR

objects.name: Wheel_FL
objects.role: 245/45 R19 tyre (sidewall bulge, 3 tread grooves), 10-spoke rim, hub, lug bolts, brake disc (spins with the wheel)
objects.spin: spin about the part's local +X axis; rolling forward (towards -Z) is a NEGATIVE angle: motor.Transform = CFrame.Angles(-distance / radius_studs, 0, 0)
objects.steer_note: positive angle about +Y turns the wheel's front towards the car's left (-X)

objects.name: Wheel_FR
objects.role: 245/45 R19 tyre (sidewall bulge, 3 tread grooves), 10-spoke rim, hub, lug bolts, brake disc (spins with the wheel)
objects.spin: spin about the part's local +X axis; rolling forward (towards -Z) is a NEGATIVE angle: motor.Transform = CFrame.Angles(-distance / radius_studs, 0, 0)
objects.steer_note: positive angle about +Y turns the wheel's front towards the car's left (-X)

objects.name: Wheel_RL
objects.role: 245/45 R19 tyre (sidewall bulge, 3 tread grooves), 10-spoke rim, hub, lug bolts, brake disc (spins with the wheel)
objects.spin: spin about the part's local +X axis; rolling forward (towards -Z) is a NEGATIVE angle: motor.Transform = CFrame.Angles(-distance / radius_studs, 0, 0)

objects.name: Wheel_RR
objects.role: 245/45 R19 tyre (sidewall bulge, 3 tread grooves), 10-spoke rim, hub, lug bolts, brake disc (spins with the wheel)
objects.spin: spin about the part's local +X axis; rolling forward (towards -Z) is a NEGATIVE angle: motor.Transform = CFrame.Angles(-distance / radius_studs, 0, 0)

objects.name: Caliper_FL
objects.role: dark-red brake caliper; does not spin; steers with Wheel_FL
objects.note: pivot = wheel centre. Front calipers: apply the same steer angle as the wheel, no spin.

objects.name: Caliper_FR
objects.role: dark-red brake caliper; does not spin; steers with Wheel_FR
objects.note: pivot = wheel centre. Front calipers: apply the same steer angle as the wheel, no spin.

objects.name: Caliper_RL
objects.role: dark-red brake caliper; does not spin
objects.note: pivot = wheel centre. Front calipers: apply the same steer angle as the wheel, no spin.

objects.name: Caliper_RR
objects.role: dark-red brake caliper; does not spin
objects.note: pivot = wheel centre. Front calipers: apply the same steer angle as the wheel, no spin.

objects.name: Interior_Front
objects.role: driver cockpit: dashboard, 2 screens, vents, column, console, gear selector, cup holders, pedals, driver + passenger seat, carpet, sill plates

objects.name: SteeringWheel
objects.role: 3-spoke steering wheel; rotate about hinge_axis
objects.hinge_axis_note: steering column axis, pointing from the dashboard towards the driver
objects.rotation_note: positive angle (right-hand rule about hinge_axis) turns the rim counter-clockwise as the driver sees it = steering LEFT

objects.name: Interior_Lounge
objects.role: lounge: carpet, long side bench (3 seats), rear bench (3 seats, armrests, cup holders), partition with window + TV, star-ceiling panel, sill plates

objects.name: Interior_Bar
objects.role: refreshment console: cabinet, mirrored back, tumblers, 2 water carafes, ice bucket with ice, cup holders, control panel (no alcohol, no labels)

objects.name: Ambient_LED
objects.role: ambient LED strips (ceiling, roof rails, bar, toe-kicks, partition)
objects.note: vertex colour white: MeshPart.Color sets the LED colour (render: 140,123,255)

objects.name: StarLights
objects.role: 150 star points of the ceiling panel

export.fbx_settings: axis_forward=Z, axis_up=Y, apply_scale_options=FBX_SCALE_UNITS, global_scale=1, bake_space_transform, mesh_smooth_type=FACE, colors_type=SRGB, triangulated, no leaf bones, no animation, path_mode=COPY+embed (no textures used)
export.blender_units: 1 Blender unit = 1 stud (scene Unit System None, Unit Scale 1.0)
